Tip: select a Sales Group first to narrow the Brand list. Fuel-powered vehicles include ICE, MHEV 48V and FHEV. New energy vehicles include BEV, PHEV, REEV and FCEV. Totals are aggregated from model/program records, so a model line can appear more than once when multiple programs or powertrains exist.
